title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.24
subtitle: Faster preparation and shared scene Flow.

highlights.title: One Flow setup for the scene
highlights.description: All enabled Cloth objects share the fluid source, coupling and .gaia cache. Influence and Velocity Scale stay individual.

highlights.title: Faster fluid preparation
highlights.description: Reconstruct a shared field once and reuse verified preparations for subsequent Bakes in the same Blender session. Full-particle reconstruction keeps identical results.

highlights.title: Less preparation overhead
highlights.description: Temporary frame changes skip diagnostic fluid previews while preserving physical meshes and restoring preview settings. Failed Bake-window connections exit cleanly.
